goals.title: Crate-by-crate release blocker inventory
goals.objective: Generate a current cargo-metadata crate roster, join it with existing crate-readiness worksheets, batch backlog, TODO/panic/unimplemented scans, test/doc presence, dependency/runtime feature wiring, and open PR/worktree evidence. Produce a structured crate-by-crate release blocker matrix under docs/quality, separating true release blockers from non-blocking follow-ups and already-covered open PRs. Add follow-up ultragoal stories for the highest-priority implementation gaps found.

codexObjective: Complete the durable ultragoal plan in .omx/ultragoal/goals.json, including later accepted/appended stories, under the original brief constraints; use .omx/ultragoal/ledger.jsonl as the audit trail.
